workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: vllm-rs render drops tools for tool_choice "none" and rejects empty content, unlike the Python frontend
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [Bugfix][Rust Frontend] Accept empty message content like the Python frontend. Target files: rust/src/server/src/routes/openai/utils/types.rs, rust/src/server/src/routes/tests.rs. The Rust frontend rejects empty user message content on `/v1/chat/completions/render` and `/tokenize` with `400 BadRequestError: message content cannot be empty`, while the Python frontend renders it as a normal (empty) turn. This PR drops the Rust-only content check so both frontends accept the same requests. (second bug, see #62741 below for t... (Ref: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/64471)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: b12x attention backend advertises head_dim 64, but every head_dim 64 model crashes at the first forward (no valid NUM_MMA_KV typed shared-memory allocation)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [Bugfix][Attention] Stop advertising head_dim 64 in the b12x backend. Target files: vllm/v1/attention/backends/b12x.py, tests/v1/attention/test_b12x.py. `--attention-backend b12x` accepts head_dim 64 models at selection and then crashes after model load, at the first forward, inside the b12x paged planner (`no valid NUM_MMA_KV typed shared-memory allocation fits the device`). The b12x package cannot plan head_dim 64 decode at all, so this stops advertising 64 and lets selection fail fast. . (Ref: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63012)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: --attention-backend b12x fails at startup without --block-size (impl checks block size before the platform applies the preferred one)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [Bugfix][Attention] Let b12x pick its default KV block size. Target files: vllm/v1/attention/backends/b12x.py, tests/v1/attention/test_b12x.py. `--attention-backend b12x` fails at startup unless `--block-size 64` or `128` is also passed: (Ref: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/62265)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Rust vllm-bench silently ignores --dataset-path with synthetic datasets (benchmarks random prompts instead of the user's file)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [Bugfix][Rust Frontend] Reject --dataset-path with synthetic vllm-bench datasets. Target files: rust/src/bench/src/cli.rs, rust/src/bench/src/config.rs, rust/src/bench/README.md. . Rust `vllm-bench` silently ignored `--dataset-path` for the synthetic datasets, so `vllm-bench --dataset-path my_workload.jsonl` without `--dataset-name` benchmarked random prompts instead of the given file. This rejects the combination with the same error as Python `vllm bench serve`. (Ref: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/64551)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Extensible KV cache undersizes the KV cache on integrated (UMA) GPUs, down to 0 blocks: free memory read with raw cudaMemGetInfo
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [Bugfix] Size the extensible KV cache from UMA-corrected free memory. Target files: vllm/platforms/cuda.py, vllm/platforms/interface.py, vllm/utils/mem_utils.py. . On integrated (UMA) GPUs the extensible KV cache (#56492) sized itself from raw `cudaMemGetInfo`, which does not count reclaimable page cache as free, so it undersized the KV cache by up to 84% on a DGX Spark (GB10) and to zero blocks in disaggregated serving. This reads free memory through one helper with the same `psutil` correction the classic sizing path al... (Ref: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/65413)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: `hadacore_transform` gives wrong results for odd row counts (INT4 per-token-head KV cache): garbage K/V and intermittent illegal memory access
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [Bugfix][Kernel] hadacore: fix skipped wait_group on partial-chunk warp for odd row counts (#63514). Target files: csrc/quantization/hadamard/hadacore/hadamard_transform_cuda.cu, tests/kernels/quantization/test_hadacore.py. When using INT4 per-token-head KV cache (`--kv-cache-dtype int4_per_token_head`), `reshape_and_cache_int4` rotates Key and Value tensors via `hadacore_transform`. For `head_dim = 256`, `num_chunks` is 2. When the row count (`num_tokens * num_kv_heads_per_rank`) is odd, the last warp receives only 1 chu... (Ref: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63614)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Kimi-K3 outputs turn into `!!!!` (token 0) streams under load (FlashKDA spreads one NaN across requests; FlashMLA SM90 decode PDL race)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [Bugfix][Kimi-K3] Pin FlashKDA and FlashMLA with NaN fixes. Target files: cmake/external_projects/flashkda.cmake, cmake/external_projects/flashmla.cmake. Fixes https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/64758: under load, some Kimi-K3 requests turn into streams of token 0 (`!!!!`) until `max_tokens`. This PR moves the FlashKDA and FlashMLA pins to commits with two kernel fixes: https://github.com/vllm-project/FlashKDA/pull/16 and https://github.com/vllm-project/FlashMLA/pull/41. (Ref: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/64759)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: CustomDataset converts numeric-string prompts to integers before tokenization
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [Bugfix][Benchmark] Keep numeric-string prompts as strings in CustomDataset. Target files: vllm/benchmarks/datasets/datasets.py, tests/benchmarks/test_custom_dataset_seed.py. . `CustomDataset.load_data()` lets `pd.read_json` infer the `prompt` column's dtype, so a JSONL file whose prompts are all numeric strings (`"00123"`, `"00456"`) is loaded as integers. Leading zeros are lost and `sample()` then fails in the tokenizer. (Ref: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/65083)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Strict serde rejection of duplicate field `reasoning` breaks agent harnesses that echo both `reasoning` and `reasoning_content`
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [Rust Frontend] Accept duplicate reasoning aliases in chat messages. Target files: rust/src/server/src/routes/openai/utils/types.rs. : the Rust frontend rejected chat requests whose assistant message carries **both** `reasoning` and `reasoning_content` with an opaque serde `duplicate field` parse error, while the Python frontend accepts the identical body. This permanently breaks multi-turn agent loops because the offending assistant turn stays in history and every follow-up request fails. (Ref: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63137)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Qwen3.5: int32 token-offset overflows in three Triton kernels give wrong outputs or illegal memory access at large `--max-num-batched-tokens`
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [Bugfix] Fix int32 token offset overflows in Qwen3.5 attention and GDN prefill kernels. Target files: vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_qk_norm_rope.py, vllm/model_executor/layers/mamba/checkpoint.py, vllm/third_party/flash_linear_attention/ops/chunk_delta_h.py. Several Triton kernels on the Qwen3.5 prefill path multiply an int32 token index by a row stride before adding it to a pointer. Triton passes integer arguments below 2^31 as int32, and `tl.program_id`, `tl.arange` and the int32 `query_start_loc` are int32 too, so t... (Ref: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63761)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Tokenizer/processor snapshot (#60825) downloads model weights it doesn't ignore (`*.ot`, `*.tflite`, ...): ~1.57 GB extra for gpt2
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [Bugfix] Skip more weight formats in the tokenizer/processor snapshot. Target files: pyproject.toml, vllm/transformers_utils/repo_utils.py. Since #60825, loading a tokenizer or processor first downloads every Hub file not matched by `_WEIGHT_FILE_PATTERNS`. That list misses several weight formats that classic repos still ship, so vLLM downloads unused weights before loading the model: about 1.57 GB extra for `openai-community/gpt2` and 534 MB for `google-bert/bert-base-uncased`. This adds those formats to the list. (Ref: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63922)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: DiffusionGemma: runtime CUDA OOM under concurrent decode (fp32 canvas×vocab temporaries)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [Bugfix][MRV2] Fix DiffusionGemma runtime OOM via tiled logits projection. Target files: vllm/model_executor/models/diffusion_gemma.py, vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_runner.py, vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_states/interface.py. - : full-batch logits grow with concurrency and OOM the first decode batch - Project logits per tile in the sampler; reserve the transient during profiling via a `profile_run` hook - Not a duplicate: #46155 is an opt-in env-var sampler; this fixes the default path (Ref: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/51953)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: [Bug]: bare `@torch.compile` in `kimi_k25_vit` compiles outside the compilation lifecycle and pins `TRITON_CACHE_DIR` process-wide
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [Bugfix] Avoid eager torch.compile in Kimi K2.5 vision helper. Target files: vllm/model_executor/models/kimi_k25_vit.py. `get_rope_shape` in the Kimi K2.5 vision encoder was decorated with bare `torch.compile`, and an eager wrapper invoked it on the first input key. This could initialize Triton before vLLM's compilation lifecycle configured its cache directories, causing warm-cache reload failures. (Ref: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53011)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Humming FP8 linear crashes on per-tensor/per-channel FP8 weights, so FP8 models cannot start with VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1 on Ampere
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [Bugfix][Quantization] Fix Humming FP8 linear for per-tensor/per-channel FP8 weights. Target files: vllm/model_executor/kernels/linear/__init__.py, vllm/model_executor/layers/quantization/fp8.py, vllm/model_executor/layers/quantization/online/fp8.py. . With the Humming FP8 linear kernel, `fp8` checkpoints with per-tensor weight scales and online `fp8_per_tensor` / `fp8_per_channel` quantization crash while loading weights. On Ampere with `VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1`, Humming is the only FP8 linear kernel left (Marlin opts out... (Ref: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/60163)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Rust vllm-bench accepts --max-concurrency 0 and hangs forever (Python rejects it since #54887)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [Bugfix][Rust Frontend] Rust vllm-bench accepts --max-concurrency 0 and hangs forever (Python rejects it since #54887). Target files: rust/src/bench/src/config.rs, rust/src/bench/src/mm_processor.rs, rust/src/bench/src/sweep.rs. Rust `vllm-bench` accepted `--max-concurrency 0` and then hung forever on `Semaphore::new(0)`, while Python `vllm bench serve` rejects 0 since #54887. This change rejects 0 fail-fast on every Rust bench path that builds a concurrency semaphore: (Ref: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/64390)
